- [cross-vendor-review-on-secrets](cross-vendor-review-on-secrets.md) — do · review, security, delegate · seen 1 — For code that handles a password or other secret, get a review from a different vendor's agent even after surgeon-reviewer passes it.
- [hc-codex-task-in-file](hc-codex-task-in-file.md) — do · hc, codex, delegate · seen 1 — When starting Codex through hc on Windows, put the task in a file and pass a one-line prompt that tells Codex to read it.
- [hc-report-to-lead-id](hc-report-to-lead-id.md) — avoid · hc, delegate · seen 1 — When delegating via hc, write your own terminal id literally in the report instruction (hc send t2h ...), never $HC_TERMINAL_ID.
- [lint-parser-input-separation](lint-parser-input-separation.md) — avoid · lint, parsing · seen 1 — Keep raw source inputs separate from lint warnings, and recognize comment delimiters only in valid comment positions.
